rubrik: Give a friend a voucher worth {van}
text: Send your link to a friend. Your friend gets a voucher worth {van} for their first purchase. Once your friend's package has shipped, you get {kredit} in store credit to spend with us.
villkor: The voucher applies to your friend's first purchase. We'll email you when your {kredit} store credit is available, and it's applied at checkout when you log in with the same email address.
